description: Score de qualité des métadonnées pour trois villes des Alpes Maritimes (06) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AntibesData. Metadata quality score published on data.gouv.fr for three towns in the Alpes Maritimes (06): Antibes, Cannes, Nice. Each line represents a published dataset as well as its score and associated city. Coverage: AntibesData. The portal shows the English title as "Metadata quality score for three cities in the Alpes Maritimes (06)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AntibesData. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-02-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
